trigger_condition: Id untracked before hint expiry: cancel, clearRows, chat switch, execution resolved
potential_consequence: Abandoned flow still fires a false 'timeout' beacon 10 minutes later

trigger_condition: Same auth_config_id re-tracked on retry while its first acceptance timer still pending
potential_consequence: Orphan timer purges retention mid-retry, beacons falsely, leaves new timer unclearable

trigger_condition: Acceptance expiry while the id is still in trackedIdsRef (WorkflowDetailsPage never untracks)
potential_consequence: Diagnostics records a timeout for a flow the page is still awaiting

trigger_condition: Late error callback arrives during retention, after hint expiry rolled the row back
potential_consequence: IdP error code never lands; user keeps the stale 'taking longer' hint

trigger_condition: Newer row for same auth_config_id sits in config_error or discovery_failed
potential_consequence: Config error silently flipped to authenticated; real in-flight row stuck authenticating

trigger_condition: User switches chats after hint expiry; late success arrives during retention
potential_consequence: Originating chat's row stays authentication_required; another chat's row flipped instead

trigger_condition: mcpAuthTimeoutSeconds configured at or above 600 seconds
potential_consequence: Both timers coincide; retention window is zero, late-callback acceptance silently disabled

trigger_condition: mcpAuthTimeoutSeconds configured above the backend 600s PKCE/callback-state TTL
potential_consequence: UI promises completion for a flow the backend already invalidated; user waits indefinitely

trigger_condition: mcpAuthTimeoutSeconds above 2147483 seconds; getPositiveInteger imposes no upper bound
potential_consequence: setTimeout overflows and fires immediately; hint and acceptance expire before any callback

trigger_condition: Beacon fired on every hint-timeout at 60s, guaranteeing a diagnostics sample
guard_snippet: Re-report at hint expiry, or flush pending acceptance beacons on unmount/pagehide
potential_consequence: Tab close or navigation before 600s drops the timeout metric entirely
